source_document: AEON Credit - Terms and Conditions for Plaza Premium Lounge Access in Malaysia and at International Airports, Version: August 2026

rules.title: Plaza Premium complimentary access

condition.excluded_spend_text: Instalment Payment Plan (IPP), Flexi Payment Plan (FPP), Balance Transfer, Ready Cash, Auto Balance Conversion (ABC), Cash Advance and Quasi Cash, Interest charges and/or finance charges, Other credit card related fees and charges.

guest.note: First accompanying infant aged 2 and below is free. Guests aged 3 and above get 25% off the listed price, paid before access.

penalty.note: RM134.00 (excluding taxes) for each access, billed within 3 months from the visit date, if the spending condition is not met and the lounge is used for a domestic Malaysia flight departure.

rules.entry_requirements: Physical AEON Credit Card and Boarding Pass. The name on both must match. Confirm whether Principal or Supplementary.
rules.notes: Spend must be on the physical card used to enter. Former name: AEON Gold Visa / Mastercard.

_source.quota: The entitlement access to the Plaza Premium Lounges is valid for one (1) calendar year, from January to December.
_source.per_day_limit: Cardholders are entitled to access any Plaza Premium Lounges ONE (1) time per day.
_source.condition: Minimum spend of RM500 in single or cumulative transactions within 30 days before and/or 30 days after the lounge visit date
_source.flight_scope: The complimentary access is only applicable to international flight departures via the physical AEON Credit Cards with minimum spending conditions
